title: Which club will Rodri join from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Rodri is a midfielder for Manchester City.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the receiving club in Rodri's first completed permanent transfer from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window. Transfer rumours, bids, and agreements in principle do not qualify. 
  Resolution Date : The date the completed transfer is officially announced. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The receiving club's commonly used name.
